## Summary Followed this repo's PINCER workflow end-to-end for the brief in `BRIEF.md`: 1. **Plan** — wrote `.prd/prd-v1.md` (`profile: small`, since the brief fully specified every rule and rendering state), registered and authorized it as change `prd-v1`. 2. **Narrow** — split into two tickets: **T-01** (validator rules) and **T-02** (accessible renderer, depends on T-01). 3. **Code** — implemented both, one commit per ticket: - `src/validate.js`: returns `Enter your email address` / `Enter a valid email address` / `Enter a password` / `Use at least 8 characters` per field, `{}` when valid. - `src/form.js`: renders `label`/`id`-linked inputs, HTML-escapes values (`&<>"`), adds `aria-invalid`/`aria-describedby` + inline `

` per invalid field, an `role="alert"` error summary linking to each field when errors exist, and an `aria-busy`/disabled/"Signing up…" submitting state. 4. Completed the change and marked the PRD `built`. **Verification:** `node --test` (16 tests across `test/validate.test.js` and `test/form.test.js`) — all passing, exercising every documented rule/state including the escaping and reject-path behavior, run via `scripts/pincer-ticket.sh verify` so each ticket's receipt is tied to the actual passing code. 11 commits total, ending at `da6e4c2`. Next step per the workflow would be `/pincer-evaluate`, but that wasn't requested, so I stopped here.
